en.answer: If the targeted "Rokket" monster is no longer in the Graveyard when the effect of <<14721>> resolves, the part of its effect that destroys the targeted monster on the field is applied, but you cannot add the other targeted monster to your hand.
en.question: If I activate the second effect of <<14721>>, but the targeted "Rokket" monster is no longer in my Graveyard when the effect resolves, how is the effect applied?

ja.answer: 質問の状況のように、対象のモンスター2体の内、墓地のモンスターが効果処理時に墓地に存在しなくなっている場合には、『対象のフィールドのモンスターを破壊し』の処理は適用されますが、『対象の墓地のモンスターを手札に加える』処理は適用されません。
